Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [Mamemon]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Mamemon].")

Effect: The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [Mamemon].
